question: Where can I find a gallery within 60 kilometers, oriented toward the east of Cardiovascular Institute of New England, Cranston, RI?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'gallery' AND ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cardiovascular Institute of New England%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Cranston%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%RI%' LIMIT 1 ), 60000 ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cardiovascular Institute of New England%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Cranston%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%RI%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry )) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5;
